data.name: CP/M for Tandy Model II with required platform services
data.specification: Model II boot/disk/printer BIOS plus native display/keyboard TUI adapter, bounded clipboard and required application services. CP/M-80 work reuses existing DRI investment; it does not imply an x86 CP/M commitment.
